title: Design System: Jamil Chowdhury - Hand-drawn science journal

display.purpose: The centred name below the animation.

body.purpose: Shared handwritten page voice from the supplied Patrick Hand asset.

fallback.purpose: The explanatory fallback below the animation canvas.

motion.name: clubroot-playback
motion.purpose: Silent supplied artwork playback, toggled by the canvas and native button.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Pause when the preference changes to reduce and permit explicit user playback.

motion.name: activity-suspension
motion.purpose: Suspend offscreen or while hidden; resume only while playback remains selected.

motion.name: animation-resize
motion.purpose: Resize at display density and redraw the current animation frame.

motion.name: journal-texture
motion.purpose: Decorative paper has no animation loop; text stays separate and selectable.

motion.name: skip-scroll
motion.purpose: Move from Skip animation to the journal.

components.name: Playback button
components.description: Native keyboard control in its observed pause state; the live page switches icon and accessible label with playback state.
components.html: <button class="ds-playback" type="button" aria-label="Pause animation" title="Pause animation"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5v14M16 5v14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-playback { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #a5aac0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--animation-paper, #f5f0e4); color: var(--animation-ink, #283d85); cursor: pointer; } .ds-playback:hover { background: #e7e6dd; } .ds-playback:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--animation-ink, #283d85); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Skip animation link
components.description: Focus-revealed anchor to the journal, preserving its position and keyboard treatment.
components.css: .ds-skip-link { position: absolute; z-index: 5; top: -100px; left: 20px; padding: 12px 18px; color: var(--ink, #343b36); background: var(--paper, #eeefeb); font-family: var(--hand, 'Patrick Hand', 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', cursive); text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-skip-link:focus { top: 12px; outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #343b36); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Grey paper journal signature
components.description: CSS paper fallback and current name-only signature. The live page adds static procedural texture through paper.js.
components.html: Jamil Chowdhury
components.css: .ds-journal { min-height: 38svh; padding: 52px 24px 88px; background: var(--paper, #eeefeb); color: var(--ink, #343b36); } .ds-journal-content { width: min(1040px, 100%); margin: 0 auto; } .ds-name { margin: 0; text-align: center; font: 400 clamp(2.7rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)/1.16 var(--hand, 'Patrick Hand', 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', cursive); letter-spacing: -.025em; text-wrap: balance; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-journal { min-height: calc(100svh - 100vw * 9 / 16 - 80px); padding: 52px 22px 80px; } }

narrative.overview:
The supplied hand-drawn scientific artwork leads the experience. Its pencil marks, handwritten labels and warm sheet remain an intact visual asset. The surrounding interface stays quiet so the science remains the focus.

The neutral grey watercolour journal preserves the existing cotton-paper tooth, fibres and subtle pigment variation. Selectable HTML text sits above this static decorative texture. Warmth belongs to the supplied animation; the journal retains its neutral grey character.
keyCharacteristics: Supplied scientific artwork with unobtrusive playback controls.
Patrick Hand lettering shared by the animation and page signature.
Neutral grey paper with static, procedural material detail.
Open spacing, flat surfaces and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Neutral Journal Rule
rules.body: Preserve the journal's grey paper character; do not extend the supplied artwork's warm sheet into it.

dos: Do retain the supplied scientific artwork, labels and captions.
Do retain visible paper tooth and fibres on the neutral grey journal.
Do keep journal text selectable and separate from the decorative canvas.
Do preserve keyboard playback, visible focus, reduced-motion handling and offscreen suspension.
Do keep mobile playback below the artwork so scientific labels remain visible.
donts: Don't introduce yellow washes, woodland scenery, trees or mushrooms into the grey journal.
Don't add biography, qualifications, employment claims or invented posts to the current name-only journal.
Don't turn the static journal paper texture into a motion effect.
